instruction: Please help me convert the receipt picture (OIP.jpg) in /home/user to a PDF file named 'receipt.pdf' and place it on the Desktop.

metadata.explanation: Task requires converting OIP.jpg to PDF with specific filename on Desktop. Evaluator checks: (1) file exists (0.4), (2) filename matches 'receipt.pdf' exactly (0.3), (3) valid PDF with content > 1KB (0.3). This validates both correct naming and successful conversion.

scoring_breakdown.0.4: PDF file exists at Desktop location
